news.text: #Juve, For The Goal, There Is The #Beltrán IdeaNegotiations are underway with #RiverPlateNot only #Vicario: they like the Argentine who is considered the successor of Dibu #Martínez in the National Team. #DiGregorio to #Bournemouth.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

"#KESSIÉ AND #ZIRKZEE. THIS IS HOW #JUVE BECOMES A SCUDETTO TEAM"#Tardelli ExclusiveThe ex World Champion: "Nobody is like #Inter, but if they complete the squad for #Spalletti, there is room for a head-to-head. #Yildiz is not yet a leader. Watch out for #Como and #Fiorentina. #Gasp will cause trouble with #Roma. OK #Allegri to #Napoli. The striker? #Pellegrino".#Perin And #DiGre Out. Revolution in goal.#Perin to #Palermo, #DiGregorio to #Bournemouth. #Beltrán from #RiverPlate has been proposed, with #Musso also in the background. #David is digging his heels in: he wants to play his chances.[Front Page TuttoSport]

👀 For the #Juventus goal, in addition to Santiago Beltrán, the name of Pietro Terracciano has also emerged.The #Milan goalkeeper, who boasts extensive Serie A experience and a past at #Fiorentina, represents a very different option compared to the young Argentine: two profiles that #Juve is evaluating for the future of the position, looking ahead to the post-#DiGregorio and #Perin.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]
Pietro #Terracciano (AC Milan) and Marco #Sportiello (Atalanta) have been offered to #Juventus for Vicario’s backup role. #transfers[Nico Schira]
👋 It's done for #DiGregorio to #Bournemouth on loan with an option to buy.[Michele De Blasis]
Michele #DiGregorio is going to #Bournemouth on loan with an option to buy: it's done ✅[IlBianconero]

GJustjuve @afcbournemouth-@juventusfc, agreement reached for Di Gregorio. @SkySport Di Marzio https://t.me/GJustjuve/71629Loan deal with an option to buy at 14 million plus bonuses. The last details need to be sorted out, then the goalkeeper will be able to travel to England @SkySport[Di Marzio]

GJustjuve Photo https://t.me/GJustjuve/71630🚨🍒 Bournemouth have agreed on loan deal to sign Michele Di Gregorio from Juventus, here we go!Paid loan with €14m buy option clause not mandatory, as Sky Sport reported.Di Gregorio will fly to England this weekend.[Fabrizio Romano]
@afcbournemouth-@juventusfc, agreement reached for Di Gregorio. @SkySportDi Marzio
